_comment: Named, self-defined item sets for select_tracked.py, referenced by presets in presets.json. Each set is a list of item ids; an optional 'cron_profile' assigns those items an enhancement cron-stone cost profile (default 'standard'), applied as a cross-cutting override so the items keep that profile no matter which preset selects them (e.g. the Deboreka series stays 'deboreka' even when picked via the broad 'accessories' preset). 'cron_profile' is currently metadata for a future calibrated enhancement-cost model (not yet consumed); series that consume cron stones differently (Deboreka, Apeiron) each get their own profile.
